title: A Reversible Continuous-Variable Photonic Memory Architecture Based on Displacement-Evolved Coherent-State Dynamics
summary: Modern information systems increasingly require memory architectures capable of storing not only static data but also the evolution of information over time. While continuous-variable photonic platforms have been extensively studied for quantum communication and computation, their potential as dynamically evolving memory systems remains largely unexplored. In this work, we introduce a metadata-assisted continuous-variable photonic memory architecture in which information is represented by latent vectors encoded across multimode coherent states and updated through reversible displacement…
